notes: rounds/tester.py result() checks the round is Open and the build current, reads the tester's own result, refuses a POST to a submitted one and gives it no form; save() then calls services.save_result under the round lock, which re-checks Open, the current build, the tester's own row and AlreadySubmitted. M1 drops the tester filter in both reads; M3 lets both Open checks pass a Closed round; M4 sets the view's 'submitted' flag to False and removes the service check, so the form is shown (status still Submitted) and a save changes the values. ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation, backed by the CheckConstraint rounds_result_fail_observation, which M2 removes from the model and migration 0005_results together (otherwise the save fails with a 503); M5 raises only ObservationField's max_length, whose message still says 2000. M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only 'Record result' link in place (navigation, not a guard). M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005_results to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
